experiments.hypothesis: The Lane 3 gross mid-to-mid shadow PnL survives realistic round-trip execution cost, and its edge is not concentrated in a subset of coins.
experiments.slice: All Invo notification shadow trades; sub-sliced by coin (BTC vs alt-coin).
experiments.retest_condition: Rerun on the full 49-close ledger rather than the 10 rows visible in probe run 33376459723, with measured book spread instead of the 9/15/25/40 bps scenario grid, and a clustered bootstrap that accounts for per-trader and per-day dependence.

experiments.hypothesis: A causal previous-day high/low liquidity-sweep reversal rule has positive execution-cost-adjusted expectancy on liquid crypto markets during the London morning and survives an untouched holdout.
experiments.slice: BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT Binance USD-M 5-minute proxy data; first 08:00-10:00 Europe/London PDH/PDL sweep-reclaim with immediate-next-bar confirmation; frozen 1R/1.5R/2R/3R targets.
experiments.retest_condition: Do not retune or rerun the frozen rule after seeing the holdout. Open a new experiment only for a materially different preregistered causal hypothesis or new Hyperliquid-specific execution evidence, with a new untouched validation window.
